messages:
sanjay: Hey @runtime @infra @security — PR 81234 is ready for final review. It contains the eviction routing fallback change + small config refactor. Need runtime + infra + security LGTM for canary and merge. Diff: https://git.internal/r/81234

elaine: quick skim — looks straightforward. left 2 tiny comments about log context, non-blocking.

tim: quick q: what's the rollout plan and canary window? want to make sure SRE can steward.

sanjay: rollout plan in the PR description but pasted here: canary 1h at 10% traffic, monitor p99 tail and eviction_rate, automatic rollback if error-rate > 0.5% for 3 consecutive mins. rollout snippet:
```
# orch/eviction/rollout.yaml (excerpt)
strategy: Canary
steps:
  - weight: 10
    pause: 60m
  - weight: 100
```

marco: runtime note — KV fallback uses shard-local namespaces, so no cross-shard state leakage. I'll still add a unit test and a small perf run against the 100k-req replay.

security-bot: SCA results: no new high/critical findings. Dependency diff clear. Scan-id: sca-2023-ev81234. (reacts :white_check_mark:)

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2023-11-10T03:00:00Z UTC. To confirm: owners = tim (canary steward), marco (runtime approver), elaine (logging/ops), sanjay (PR author).

elaine: also please add a short sentence in the PR description that lists the dashboards to watch: `eviction_rate`, `tail_p99_latency`, `model_cache_hit`.

sanjay: good call, added that now. also adding `ok-to-ship` label after runtime sign-off.

marco: I can do a perf + kv-consistency check by 17:30 PT and post results here.

tim: I'll take stewarding for the canary window this weekend. If runtime posts green results and security stays clear, I'll flip the merge.

sanjay: perfect. one question for infra: the config tweak touches the allocator flags — infra, any objections to merge during normal window?

marco: allocator change is opt-in via feature flag; no infra objections from me. will add a test to cover the flag-off behavior.

elaine: non-blocking comments addressed. left one nit on a log line.

sanjay: thanks — aiming to get runtime LGTM by EOD. If we have that, we'll merge and kick the scheduled canary. Appreciate the quick turns on this :pray:

elaine: :thumbsup:

marco: :eyes: posting test artifacts in the PR when done.

security-bot: Reminder: please attach the threat-model checklist for infra-facing changes.

sanjay: adding the checklist to the PR description now.

deploy-bot: Canary trigger will post results summary here automatically.

marco: all tests passed locally, perf looks fine (p50/p95 unchanged, p99 +2ms). pushed a tiny unit test. PR updated.

tim: thanks — I'll watch the canary and post the final status. +1 pending runtime + security sign-off.

sanjay: closing loop — pinging @security for final review. Appreciate everyone moving fast on this.
